description: Empty the drawing (v1.common.clear), to start over in it: a drawing persists between requests, part.create refuses a second root, and anything built on the old part would carry its geometry along. For a new, unrelated model next to this one, open a new drawing instead (drawing: "new"). Not needed for changes to the current model. The graphic and renders are empty afterwards too — no reconnect needed.

drawing.description: The drawing this call works on. "new" opens a new, empty drawing, and the answer names its id; from then on pass that id (e.g. "d-k3v9q2xa") in every call of this conversation about that model. A drawing belongs to the conversation that opened it: no other conversation can see or change it.

keepIds.description: Object IDs to preserve. Omit to wipe everything.

name: clear
title: Clear drawing
